target.statement_es: Para todo n ≥ 1, n pasos de tamaño 1 (L = 1): f(xₙ) − f(x*) ≤ ‖x₀ − x*‖²/(2n). Es la cota clásica de libro de texto para el descenso de gradiente con paso 1/L.
target.prelude:
primrec gd :: "('a::real_inner \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "gd g [] x = x"
| "gd g (h # hs) x = gd g hs (x - h *\<^sub>R g x)"
target.fixes: f :: "'a::real_inner \<Rightarrow> real" and g :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and x0 xs :: 'a and n :: nat
target.assumes:
interp: "\<And>x y. f y + inner (g y) (x - y) + (1/2) * (norm (g x - g y))\<^sup>2 \<le> f x"
    and opt: "g xs = 0"
target.concl: 0 < n \<Longrightarrow> f (gd g (replicate n 1) x0) - f xs \<le> (norm (x0 - xs))\<^sup>2 / (2 * real n)
